blocks_element.text: Choose your dry shampoo based on when you’re most likely to use it or for the look and feel you want. blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · How do dry shampoos clean hair?
blocks_element.text: How do dry shampoos clean hair?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Many dry shampoos do not actually clea…
blocks_element.text: Many dry shampoos do not actually clean hair. They soak up oils, but in their place leave powders and residue. That’s not clean hair — that’s just dirty hair in disguise. In 2015, Living Proof set out to change that: We launched our Living Proof Perfect hair Day™ Dry Shampoo that’s formulated to actually clean hair, eliminating oil, sweat and odor. Since then, we’ve added Living Proof Perfect hair Day™ Advanced Clean Dry Shampoo to our offerings — it doesn’t just clean hair, it also cares for it as well, adding softness, manageability, and shine. It’s formulated to mimic the cleaning process and care benefits of a rinse-out shampoo, but without the shower. The cleaning process is simple: · First, our new delivery system starts the cleaning process with a uniform application, allowing fast-absorbing powders to soak up oil, sweat, and odor. · Then, the new powder removal system easily eliminates activated powders for a fresh start. · Finally, our finishing and conditioning ingredient blend refreshes your scalp, balances sebum levels, and leaves hair conditioned, soft, shiny, and more manageable.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Do dry shampoos leave a white residue?
blocks_element.text: Do dry shampoos leave a white residue?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Many dry shampoos soak up oils and in …
blocks_element.text: Many dry shampoos soak up oils and in their place leave powders that are difficult to remove, thus leaving a visible white and textured residue on your hair. However, with our dry shampoos, white residue that’s easy to remove is normal and expected — especially if you have dark hair. The white residue highlights where you’ll need to shake out powders, while the powder removal system works to leave behind no visible residue after shaking or combing out your hair. Allow us to reintroduce you to your hair that only feels and looks like it’s freshly washed.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · Is dry shampoo bad for your hair?
blocks_element.text: Is dry shampoo bad for your hair?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · No, and not all dry shampoos are creat…
blocks_element.text: No, and not all dry shampoos are created alike. In fact, by using our Perfect hair Day™ Advanced Clean Dry Shampoo, you’ll be able to go longer between rinse-out shampoo washes and reduce the amount of harmful heat styling. Frequent washing and styling increases the amount of damage and puts sebum production into overdrive as your scalp attempts to rebalance its levels. Using our Perfect hair Day™ Advanced Clean Dry Shampoo in between washes means that you can wash and style less frequently, lowering the exposure to these damaging events and ultimately improving hair health over time. Some other great benefits of using Living Proof dry shampoo include: · Quick and convenient · Cleans and cares like a rinse-out shampoo · Delivers a clean-smelling scent · Keeps styled or curly hair intact · Allows you to preserve colored hair longer · Saves you time in your day

When you visit our website, we store cookies on your browser to collect information. The information collected might relate to you, your preferences or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to and to provide a more personalized web experience. Residents of certain states (such as, California and Virginia) have the right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information to or with third parties (as those terms are defined under law). While we do not sell personal information in exchange for money, certain data collection activities on our sites and applications for purposes of interest-based advertising and social media tools may be a sale or sharing under California privacy law, and targeted advertising under Virginia law.

You can choose to opt out of certain types of cookies by clicking the “Submit” button below. Alternatively, you can customize the cookies you choose to opt out of by clicking Cookie Preferences. You cannot opt-out of our Strictly Necessary Cookies as they are deployed in order to ensure the proper functioning of our website (such as remembering your settings, to log into your account, to redirect you when you log out, etc.). Opting out may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

In addition to clicking Submit , you may choose to provide the information requested in this opt-out form, which may enable us to take action on your opt-out election more broadly than just on this digital property.
